item.title: LOT-107: image loading setting (never / Wi-Fi / always)
item.body:
LOT-107
Closes #198
Closes #155 (FEAT-011; this is its last lot)
Claim: cloud/lot-107

**Problem**: the reader already honours `display_images` (LOT-083, default Wi-Fi), but nothing in the app lets the user set it.

**Cause**: LOT-119 settings screen had no row for it.

**Change** (no wider): `GeneralSettingsModel.imageLoading` (key `display_images`, legacy raw values yes/no/wifi) + "Images externes" picker in Réglages › Général; `docs/features/FEAT-011.md` and a short `docs/lots/LOT-107-image-loading-setting.md`. No engine change.

**Tests** (`GeneralSettingsModelTests`): default Wi-Fi and legacy values imported; write-through and effect on `ReaderSettings` with a stubbed Wi-Fi flag; private host blocked whatever the setting. They need the new `imageLoading` property, so they do not compile without it.

**Mac check needed**
- [ ] Réglages › Général shows "Images externes" with 3 choices, default "Wi-Fi uniquement".
- [ ] Toujours: external images load on cellular; Jamais: placeholder on tap even on Wi-Fi; Wi-Fi: auto on Wi-Fi, tap on cellular.
- [ ] Change applies on the next page opened; HFR smileys/avatars unaffected.
- [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL, iPad.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added an external image setting with options to always load images, load them on Wi-Fi only, or load them only when tapped. Wi-Fi only is the default. HFR images and blocked hosts remain handled separately.
* **Documentation**
  * Added documentation describing the setting, its behavior, and how existing preferences are handled. Marked the feature as complete.
